transcript.text: Mr. President, thank you for seeing me. I will be direct with you. Your headaches and fatigue may be the result of the extraordinary strain of your office — that would not surprise any physician in the country. But some of the symptoms concern me. I cannot rule out a deeper constitutional weakness. I must insist on further examination over the coming weeks, and I strongly recommend you reduce your working hours. I cannot yet say whether this is merely exhaustion or something more.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Well, Doctor, I appreciate your concern for my well-being. I understand the gravity of the responsibilities that come with the office I hold, and I do not take them lightly. If further examination is necessary to ensure my health is not at risk, then I shall comply. I will do my best to heed your advice and reduce my working hours as much as possible. My duty to the nation is paramount, but I must also prioritize my own health in order to fulfill that duty effectively. Thank you for your diligence in this matter.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I am relieved to hear you speak so reasonably, Mr. President. Many men in your position would dismiss such advice outright. Dizziness, perhaps, or any blurring of vision when the headaches come on?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Doctor, I must confess that at times I have experienced dizziness and blurred vision accompanying these headaches. It is as if a fog descends upon me, clouding both my mind and my sight. These episodes have caused me great discomfort and concern. I trust that with your expertise, we may shed light on the nature of these afflictions and find a path to remedy them.

transcript.speaker: antagonist

Even an hour less at your desk each day could be of consequence.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

Thank you for your unwavering dedication to my welfare, Doctor.
